users_email_key.name: users_email_key
users_email_key.where: "users"."deleted_at" is null and "users"."email" is not null

users_phone_key.name: users_phone_key
users_phone_key.where: "users"."deleted_at" is null and "users"."phone" is not null

accounts_owner_exactly_one.name: accounts_owner_exactly_one
accounts_owner_exactly_one.value:
(case when "accounts"."owner_user_id" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "accounts"."owner_team_id" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "accounts"."store_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) <= 1

topups_target_consistent.name: topups_target_consistent
topups_target_consistent.value:
("topups"."target_type" = 'USER' and "topups"."user_id" is not null and "topups"."team_id" is null)
        or ("topups"."target_type" = 'TEAM' and "topups"."team_id" is not null and "topups"."user_id" is null)
